title: OR-05 · Task prediction and readouts
summary: Estimate externally defined targets from representations while keeping target readouts separate from latent dynamics and policies.

goals.title: Define the operation contract
goals.description: Define the target, information horizon, allowed inputs, readout capacity, output uncertainty and abstention conditions.

milestones.title: Specify inputs, outputs and requirements
milestones.description: Define the target, information horizon, allowed inputs, readout capacity, output uncertainty and abstention conditions. Create the Operation Contract and linked Requirements-and-Evidence Record before an experiment is admitted. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: The versioned Operation Contract and linked Requirements-and-Evidence Record specify input/output roles, claim scope, operation parameters, and typed failure or abstention conditions; existing charter links are design references, not evidence that this milestone is complete.

The contract inherits foundations-record-validation, foundations-temporal-integrity, foundations-data-protocol and foundations-lifecycle-admission. Any not-applicable rule is justified; a reusable interface can be drafted before instance selection, but an admitted run binds every required dataset, provider, artifact and protocol dependency.

Declare whether each target describes observed content or a future outcome, its support interval and label-availability boundary. Specify accessible metadata, encoder freeze/adaptation policy and readout capacity; target readout, latent dynamics and policy interfaces remain distinct.

milestones.title: Define a bounded diagnostic recoverability protocol
milestones.description: Provide a lightweight reusable probe pattern for explicitly authorized representation providers. It uses compact contracts and development data rather than a non-admitted loophole; results remain exploratory recoverability evidence until a separate confirmatory protocol is admitted.
acceptance: Bind the provider/instance and output contract, development-only source population, a few predeclared simple targets, target timing, fixed small readout family, fit/selection budget, seeds, baseline inputs and evidence destination in a compact Operation Contract and Requirements-and-Evidence Record.

Use the shared temporal, provenance, permission and run-index rules. The protected confirmation set is not consumed, and diagnostic labels, budgets or a provider comparison cannot override CPB’s existing pause or external-service authorization limits.

Report only the target recoverability measured under the specified probe, with matched-information controls and explicit unsupported/unknown cases. Compare different encoders only on declared common content/targets and information budgets; incompatible modalities or unseen training exposure limit the comparison.

Log all tried targets/configurations and selection decisions. A result used to choose an encoder or operation requires fresh or properly separated confirmation before supporting an admitted operation-quality or superiority claim.

evidence.label: Proposed corrections and acceptance rationale; not execution evidence

goals.title: Provide a reference implementation
goals.description: Provide a fitted readout whose preprocessing, capacity, labels and artifacts are bound to training splits and encoder identity.

milestones.title: Implement the agreed operation interface
milestones.description: Provide a fitted readout whose preprocessing, capacity, labels and artifacts are bound to training splits and encoder identity. The method, dataset and implementation slice remain to be selected. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: Conformance tests exercise the declared role/SpaceRef relationship, applicable temporal checks, malformed or unsupported inputs, stale fitted artifacts and explicit failure propagation; no rejected record becomes an ordinary vector or unreported omission.

Outputs retain parent/source lineage, representation kind, OperationRun identity, code/configuration and fitted-artifact identities. Engineering fixtures are labeled engineering-only and do not establish operation quality.

Fit readout, preprocessing and target-dependent selections only on permitted training/development data. Keep input metadata separate from evaluator-only target information and retain the exact encoder/output-selector identity.

goals.title: Establish operation-specific evidence
goals.description: Compare target quality, calibration and robustness under matched inputs and budgets; keep latent prediction and decision claims separate.

milestones.title: Define and execute the admitted evaluation
milestones.description: Compare target quality, calibration and robustness under matched inputs and budgets; keep latent prediction and decision claims separate. Freeze the selected protocol, baselines and failure criteria before held-out assessment; retain negative outcomes and limitations. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: The admitted protocol fixes data partitions, instance and artifact identities, baselines, budgets, selection policy, metrics and failure criteria before held-out assessment. Diagnostic exposure, changes and repeated looks are indexed; a revised protocol does not silently reuse an exposed confirmation set.

Report the declared evaluation unit, uncertainty or its justified limitation, coverage including abstentions and failures, and relevant resource costs. Index every initiated run and its outcome under foundations-evidence-ledger; do not discard unsuccessful or inconclusive evidence.

A valid completed evaluation can be negative or inconclusive. Milestone completion is not a positive claim verdict, and invalid or unexecuted attempts alone cannot satisfy operation-quality evaluation acceptance.

Use matched-information and declared capacity/resource controls. A probe establishes only recoverability under its selected model and scope; it does not establish information-theoretic sufficiency, latent forecast quality or decision utility. Confirmatory promotion follows or-05-readouts-probe-protocol.

goals.title: Expose Hx05 capabilities as a reusable toolset
goals.description: Expose this Hero's developed components, validation, workflows and results through a consistent discover/configure/check/run/inspect command-line interface and reusable APIs across compatible representation providers. Cover target/readout configuration, input and artifact checks, permitted fitting, prediction, diagnostic evaluation and result inspection; preserve operation-specific contracts and evidence limits as capabilities are selected and developed.

milestones.title: Define the public toolset surface and coverage
milestones.description: Map target and timing specification, permitted preprocessing/readout fitting, fitted-artifact validation, prediction, bounded probe evaluation and result/evidence inspection into public components and workflows.
acceptance: Inventory implemented and selected future public capabilities, their owning components, contracts, request/result schemas, reusable APIs, composition points, gaps and claim levels; distinguish available tools from proposed work.

The surface binds encoder/output-selector identity, accessible metadata, target availability, fitted preprocessing, readout capacity and training/development/assessment roles. Exploratory recoverability, confirmed target quality, latent dynamics and decision utility retain their separate claim boundaries.

Specify discover/configure/check/run/inspect behavior across compatible representation providers, declaring required roles, SpaceRefs, geometry and dependencies without assuming a universal vector shape or provider suitability.

milestones.title: Expose and verify the agreed tools and workflows
milestones.description: Expose the agreed building blocks and composed workflows through the common command-line and reusable API boundary, keeping operation logic with its owning component and retaining inspectable results.
acceptance: Verify the agreed representation-to-readout workflow and independently callable components, including split-bound preprocessing and fitting, stale artifact rejection, unavailable-target handling and failure or abstention reporting. Diagnostic probe evidence remains labeled exploratory unless its separate confirmation criteria are met.

CLI and reusable API examples and conformance checks cover compatible provider interchange and explicit incompatibility, malformed input, failure and abstention; retain source/parent lineage, configuration, fitted-artifact identities and complete outcome accounting.

Record implemented coverage, remaining gaps and evidence for each agreed public capability and composed workflow. Reusable engineering checks do not authorize paused research or establish operation quality; new experimental claims retain their own admitted contracts, protocols and permissions.
